          function createDot(index) {

          function renderSlides() {
            track.innerHTML = '';
            dotsWrap.innerHTML = '';
            slides.forEach(function (item, index) {

              dotsWrap.appendChild(createDot(index));

          function getSlideStep() {
            if (isMobile()) {
              return viewport.clientWidth;
            }
            var slideEl = track.querySelector('.e7-banner-0612__slide');
            if (!slideEl) return 0;
            var gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).gap) || 12;
            return slideEl.offsetWidth + gap;
          }

          function syncSlideSizes() {
            var viewportWidth = viewport.clientWidth;
            var gap = isMobile() ? 0 : (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).gap) || 12);
            var slideWidth = isMobile() ? viewportWidth : Math.round(viewportWidth * 0.88);
            root.style.setProperty('--e7-slide-width', slideWidth + 'px');
            track.querySelectorAll('.e7-banner-0612__slide').forEach(function (slide) {
              slide.style.width = slideWidth + 'px';
              slide.style.flexBasis = slideWidth + 'px';
            });
          }

          function setMobilePlusState(mobilePlus, expanded) {
            if (!mobilePlus) return;
            mobilePlus.textContent = expanded ? '-' : '+';
            mobilePlus.setAttribute('aria-expanded', expanded ? 'true' : 'false');
            mobilePlus.setAttribute('aria-label', expanded ? 'Collapse details' : 'View details');
          }

          function collapseAllSlides() {
            track.querySelectorAll('.e7-banner-0612__slide').forEach(function (slide) {
              slide.classList.remove('is-expanded');
              setMobilePlusState(slide.querySelector('.e7-banner-0612__plus--mobile'), false);
            });
          }

          function toggleMobileExpand(slide) {
            var willExpand = !slide.classList.contains('is-expanded');
            collapseAllSlides();
            if (willExpand) {
              slide.classList.add('is-expanded');
              setMobilePlusState(slide.querySelector('.e7-banner-0612__plus--mobile'), true);
            }
          }

          function updateCarousel() {
            syncSlideSizes();
            track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (currentIndex * getSlideStep()) + 'px)';
            dotsWrap.querySelectorAll('.e7-banner-0612__dot').forEach(function (dot, index) {
              dot.classList.toggle('is-active', index === currentIndex);
            });
            prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
            nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex === slides.length - 1;
            collapseAllSlides();
          }

          function goTo(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= slides.length) return;
            currentIndex = index;
            updateCarousel();

            var item = slides[index];
            if (!item) return;
            modalImg.src = item.popupImageSrc || '';

            modalTitle.textContent = item.popupTitle || '';
            modalDesc.innerHTML = item.popupDescription || '';
            modal.classList.add('is-open');
            modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

          function closeModal() {
            modal.classList.remove('is-open');
            modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';

              modalClose.innerHTML = '<img src="' + E7_BANNER_0612_CONFIG.closeBtnSrc + '" alt="Close" />';
            }
          }

          renderSlides();
          setupCloseBtn();
          updateCarousel();

          prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            goTo(currentIndex - 1);
          });

          nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            goTo(currentIndex + 1);
          });

          dotsWrap.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            var dot = event.target.closest('.e7-banner-0612__dot');
            if (!dot) return;
            goTo(Number(dot.getAttribute('data-index')));
          });

          track.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            var plusBtn = event.target.closest('.e7-banner-0612__plus--pc');
            if (!plusBtn || isMobile()) return;
            openModal(Number(plusBtn.getAttribute('data-index')));
          });

          track.addEventListener('touchstart', function (event) {
            if (!isMobile()) return;
            if (event.target.closest('.e7-banner-0612__plus--mobile')) return;
            touchStartX = event.touches[0].screenX;
          }, { passive: true });

          track.addEventListener('touchend', function (event) {
            if (!isMobile()) return;
            if (event.target.closest('.e7-banner-0612__plus--mobile')) return;
            var touchEndX = event.changedTouches[0].screenX;
            var diff = touchEndX - touchStartX;
            if (Math.abs(diff) < 50) return;
            if (diff < 0) goTo(currentIndex + 1);
            else goTo(currentIndex - 1);
          }, { passive: true });

          modalClose.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

          modal.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            if (event.target === modal) closeModal();
          });

            event.stopPropagation();
          });

          document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
            if (!modal.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
            if (event.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
          });

          window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
            if (isMobile() && modal.classList.contains('is-open')) {
              closeModal();
            }
            updateCarousel();
          });
